title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.40901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As publications and products on time series forecasting (TSF) proliferate, researchers face a growing burden of analyzing existing work. First, not all publications release code. For instance, only about 20% of arXiv TSF papers have a code link in the surveyed period. Second, released code also requires manual maintenance. Thus, TSF researchers must constantly adapt or implement existing works. However, independent implementations can differ in experimental settings and are difficult to maintain. We therefore propose to use AI agents for benchmarking TSF research and even supporting autoresearch, e.g., developing new TSF models. Yet directly applying existing coding agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, is suboptimal: prohibitive costs, limited scalability to large research projects (e.g., benchmarking), and lack of self-maintenance. translated_title: TSFLab：一个面向时间序列预测研究的自改进、智能体无关的工作台
translated_abstract: 随着时间序列预测（TSF）领域的出版物和产品不断增多，研究人员在分析现有工作方面面临着日益沉重的负担。首先，并非所有出版物都发布了代码。例如，在调查期间，只有大约20%的arXiv TSF论文附有代码链接。其次，已发布的代码也需要人工维护。因此，TSF研究人员必须不断地改编或重新实现现有的工作。然而，独立实现在实验设置上可能存在差异，且难以维护。为此，我们提出使用AI智能体对TSF研究进行基准测试，甚至支持自动化研究，例如开发新的TSF模型。然而，直接应用现有的编程智能体（如Claude Code和Codex）并非最优选择：其成本高昂、难以扩展到大型研究项目（例如基准测试），且缺乏自我维护能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TSFLab，一个自改进且与智能体无关的“工作台”，为……
tldr: 提出TSFLab——一个自改进、与智能体无关的工作台，旨在解决时间序列预测研究中代码发布率低、维护成本高以及现有编程智能体成本高、扩展性差的问题，从而支持TSF研究的基准测试与自动化研究。
en_tdlr: TSFLab is proposed as a self-improving, agent-agnostic workbench that overcomes low code availability, high maintenance costs, and the limitations of existing coding agents in time series forecasting research, enabling benchmarking and automated research.
